dedupe_keys.name: sismica lineas seg p1 y secciones sismicas tif

description: Sísmica – Líneas (SEG-P1) y Secciones Sísmicas (TIF) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. Navigation of reflection seismic profiles and reflection seismic sections or profiles. Coverage: Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. The portal shows the English title as "Seismic – Lines (SEG-P1) and Seismic Sections (TIF)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. Its keywords include Sección sísmica, Navegación línea sísmica, Geofísica, Sísmica, SIGEOF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.igme.es/condiciones-de-uso/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
